title: Resolution Rules for HostCover Claims: Filing Window and Guest Payment Requests
content:
A host claims for guest damage under **Host Damage Protection (HostCover)** by filing a claim on the stay and, where the level requires a guest request first, by first asking the guest of that stay to pay. Every HostCover level requires the guest request first.

## Rules

1. **Filing window.** A payment request is sent to the guest only for a claim filed within the level's filing window in calendar days after the stay's check-out date; the days are counted from the check-out date to the date part of the claim's filing time, and a claim filed on the last day stands. The window is 14 calendar days on HostCover Essential, Standard, Plus and Premier, and 30 on HostCover Elite and Estate.
2. **Guest response.** The guest has the level's guest response time, 72 elapsed hours on every level, from the request to pay in full, pay part, or decline. Only the guest can pay, and paying is the guest's own act.
3. **Effect of a guest payment.** A guest payment is credited to the host and reduces what Roamhaven pays. A payment reversed by the guest's card issuer is recovered from the host's payouts.
4. **One claim per category.** A claim may be filed only once per stay per damage category.
5. **Minimum.** A claimed amount below the level's minimum claimed amount is not accepted.

## Filing window, day by day (hypothetical stay checking out on 2026-05-01, 14-day window)

| Claim filed at | Days from check-out to filing date | Payment request may be sent |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-05-15 at 23:40 | 14 | Yes, filed on the last day |
| 2026-05-16 at 00:10 | 15 | No |

Only the date part of the filing time counts: a claim filed late in the evening of the last day stands, and one filed just after midnight the next day does not. On a 30-day level the same check-out date makes 2026-05-31 the last day.

## Guest response window (hypothetical)

A request sent at 15:00 on 2 June gives the guest until 15:00 on 5 June, 72 elapsed hours later, to pay in full, pay part or decline.
